usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with JSON body {model, messages[], max_tokens}
usage.outputShape: body.choices[0].message.content (OpenAI-compatible chat completion); token usage at body.usage
quirks: OpenAI-compatible chat completions API; pass model: zai/glm-5.1 (also supports glm-5, glm-5-turbo per description)
Payment via x402 USDC on Base, settled per-call; price varies by tokens
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with an OpenAI-style JSON body: {"model":"zai/glm-5.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}. Optionally set max_tokens. Payment is x402 USDC on Base, automatically settled per call (~$0.001 for a tiny prompt; scales with tokens). Read the assistant reply from body.choices[0].message.content and token usage from body.usage.
